name_story.story: Nedim can be understood through the Arabic form نَدِيم, whose central sense is nedim; companion, confidant. Nedim is the Bosnian/Turkish form of Arabic نَدِيم (Nadīm), meaning 'companion, confidant'.

faq.a: Nedim is associated with the Arabic form نَدِيم, whose core sense is nedim; companion, confidant.

faq.q: What is the origin of Nedim?
faq.a: Nedim is associated with Arabic. Nedim is the Bosnian/Turkish form of Arabic نَدِيم (Nadīm), meaning 'companion, confidant'.
Yes — the underlying form نَدِيم is Arabic.
Nedim can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Nedim should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Nadīm is not a Quranic personal name.

faq.q: What does Nedim mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Nedim is rendered ندیم and carries the sense ندیم، ساتھی.

faq.q: What does Nedim mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Nedim is rendered ندیم and carries the sense ندیم، همنشین.
A romanized syllable approximation is ne-dim. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Nedim?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Nedim, nedim. Script forms are نديم, ندیم, نَدِيم, नदीम.

faq.q: Is Nedim a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
